name: Xshielder iPhone 17 Pro Max
summary: A flameproof (Ex db) cover for the Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, dual ATEX and IECEx certified for Zone 1 and 21 with a T6 temperature class. Organisations keep the same iPhone, apps and device management they use everywhere else.
imageAlt: Worker in a high-visibility jacket holding an iPhone in an Xshielder Ex case

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T6 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db

strengths: Dual ATEX and IECEx certificates with published certificate numbers
T6 temperature class, the strictest rating
Runs iOS 27 with 6+ years of Apple-controlled updates
Same device as the rest of the fleet: native Apple Business Manager, Jamf and Intune support
limitations: The cover can only be opened by Xshielder-authorised personnel
